programme.title: KICK 't MET. Interview: Kenneth Taylor
programme.desc: Kenneth Taylor candidly looks back on his switch from his familiar 'warm bath' at Ajax to Serie A top club Lazio Roma. programme.title: I was a king – Grzegorz Piechna | S01E03
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. The hero of the third episode is the top scorer from the 2005/2006 season, Grzegorz Piechna. The excellent form of the Korona Kielce striker was one of the biggest surprises of the entire competition. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. The hero of the third episode is the top scorer from the 2005/2006 season, Grzegorz Piechna. Atomic Dog» Originally from Jackson (Mississippi), a state in the deep American south, Audie Norris (1960) is considered the best foreign player for Barça basketball. In the six years he was in the Barça team he won three leagues and two King's Cups. He spent three seasons in the NBA, in Portland, the same city and the same team where Fernando Martín played. Two players who revitalized a sport with their colossal duels in the paint. He was fired from Barça in 1993. A year later, in the Greek Peristeri, he left basketball because of his knees, the only ones that managed to stop him on the court and which tormented him throughout his entire career. He returned to the US. Bad investments left him on the brink of bankruptcy. He decided to turn his life around and return to the city that saw him shine. And 28 years after being fired he has returned to the club of his life. Since 2021 he has been a Barça ambassador

As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. This is one of the most exciting conservation success stories in AfricaAfrica's Wild Horizons is a documentary series that takes the viewers on a fantastic journey to Africa's lands, completely untouched by civilization. programme.title: Evolution Earth (S1E1). Documentary about nature. USA, 2023. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep1 «Evolution Earth»…Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planetEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Oliver TwinchCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

S1, Ep6 «Amazing Animal Friends»…Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including «ranch manager» Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongoosesAmazing Animal Friends is a heart-warming, fun and fascinating series showcasing the most incredible stories of unusual animal friendships from around the world. From an orphaned rhino calf and her dog and sheep companions in South Africa, to the duck who's obsessed with a dog in France and the elephant who thinks she's a buffalo in Zimbabwe, we reveal the cutest, funniest and unexpected animal relationships in the world. The series discovers what brings these species together, explores how they form their extraordinary bonds and examines the behaviours that influence and affect each relationshipDirector: Justin Purefoy, Gaetan MourgueCast: Kingsley Lara

programme.title: Island of the Monsoon: Web of Life (S1E4). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2018. S1, Ep4
programme.desc: 2018 г. Год: 2018. Страна: Anglija. Год: 2018. S1, Ep4 «Island of the Monsoon»…A manmade lake in Minneriya National Park supports the largest concentration of elephants in Asia. Follow a young male who has reached a turning point toward adulthood. In the rainforest, jungles teem with a variety of bizarre species of insectsIsland of the Monsoon is a nature documentary series exploring the wildlife on the island of Sri Lanka, a home to a variety of amazing animal species. They live in extreme weather conditions, from the tropical rainforests to the dry lowlands and mountain tops facing monsoons. Follow the stories of individual creatures on this unique island, as they hunt, mate and adapt to survive, from a newborn elephant to dangerous predators like leopards and crocodilesDirector: Hannah HoareCast: Robert Blythe

programme.title: Africa's Wild Horizons: Crowded Islands (S2E4). Documentary about nature, adventure. USA, 2017. S2, Ep4
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: JAV. Год: 2017. S2, Ep4 «Africa's Wild Horizons»…On rocky islands off the coast of South Africa, thousands of creatures congregate to breed. Among these, huge colonies of cape gannets dominate. Surrounded by rich waters, they can find enough to feed themselves and their young. But life is full of challenges for the breeding gannets…Africa's Wild Horizons is a documentary series that takes the viewers on a fantastic journey to Africa's lands, completely untouched by civilization. Feel its untamed wilderness, uncover mystical secrets, explore its one-of-a-kind flora and fauna, home to iconic animals and creatures of all possible kinds, where every day is an endless struggle for survival, and only the strongest stays alive. Take a look at Waterberg- a South African land formed before terrestrial life itself, the Vredefort Dome- a crater left after a giant meteorite crash, Swaziland's endless savanna, ecosystem of the Kalahari and the Okavango and much more.Director: Werner Heffer

programme.title: Evolution Earth (S1E1). Documentary about nature. USA, 2023. S1, Ep1
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: JAV. Год: 2023. S1, Ep1 «Evolution Earth»…Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planetEvolution Earth embarks on a global expedition to reveal the animals keeping pace with a planet changing at superspeed. Heading out across the globe to distant wilds and modern urban environments, five episodes track how animals are moving, using ingenuity to adapt their behavior, and even evolving in unexpected ways. At the front lines of this rapid change are the scientists, filmmakers and local communities recording the animals' stories. We follow heart-warming tales of resilience that redefine our understanding of evolution, and hint at how nature can show us a path towards a sustainable future for Planet Earth. The series is narrated by Dr. Shane Campbell-Staton, who guides us through each episode in an intimate narrative style, drawing on his background as an evolutionary biologistDirector: Oliver TwinchCast: Shane Campbell-Staton

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School: Outbreak Alert (S3E4). Documentary about nature. New Zealand, 2023. S3, Ep4
programme.desc: 2023 г. Год: 2023. Страна: Naujoji Zelandija. Год: 2023. S3, Ep4 «Orangutan Jungle School»…Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sri's plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food storeCaptivating documentary series that follows the work of the Nyaru Menteng Orangutan Rescue Centre in Borneo, Indonesia, which is the largest orangutan rehabilitation centre in the world. People who work here are dedicated to rescuing orangutans that have been displaced from their habitat or kept as illegal pets, and they do their best to help them adjust and teach them the skills necessary to survive on their own when they return to the jungle. Hear some incredible stories and follow the antics, triumphs and tragedies of a group of orphaned orangutans as they go through «Orangutan Jungle School»Cast: Rebecca Parr

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 3 s.
programme.desc: Rob is tackling one of his most complex surgeries to date. The cat's mysterious symptoms worry Alex. Scott look at the bird lump. Australia

programme.title: d/s Journey of Chinese plants. 10 s.
programme.desc: Embark on an exciting botanical journey through China! In the documentary series, we will follow the amazing journey of Chinese plants, which have had a huge impact on the world's flora and culture. You will learn how tea, rice, bamboo and many other plants became symbols of China and spread throughout the world. China

programme.title: d/f Teide: land born from fire
programme.desc: Prepare for an exciting journey to Teide, a volcano that towers over Tenerife like a guardian from ancient times. In this documentary, you will discover a land born of fire, where every rock bears traces of violent eruptions of the past. Explore unique landscapes reminiscent of the surfaces of other planets and discover how life adapts to these extreme conditions

programme.title: d/s Ancient China from a bird's eye view (Yunnan)
programme.desc: Welcome to Yunnan, one of the most picturesque and diverse regions of China! An unforgettable journey awaits you through the majestic mountains, ancient cities and flowering valleys of Yunnan province. Dir.: Anthony Barwell, Christopher O'Donnell. United Kingdom

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (Arctic)
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (American Prairies)
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA

programme.title: d/s African stories of the cheetah family. 5 s.
programme.desc: And in East Africa, Matto Barfuss in 2013, north of the Serengeti, came across a cheetah - Maleika. Matto was convinced that she was Diana's great-granddaughter. He decided to share the story of this incredible cheetah with the world. Spain

programme.title: d/s Living Nature (Rivers. Living arteries)
programme.desc: Rivers are the living arteries of the Earth, giving life to everything around. They nourish forests, fill oceans, shape landscapes, and provide homes for a variety of creatures, creating unique ecosystems. Russia

programme.title: d/s Living Nature (Seas and oceans. New horizons)
programme.desc: The seas and oceans hold many mysteries, and scientists continue to discover new horizons. Research helps to better understand the underwater world and its impact on life on Earth. Russia

programme.title: d/s Return of the Disappeared (Return of the Tiger)
programme.desc: In the new issue, we will trace the incredible path of the tiger's return. South Korea

programme.title: t/s Wild Killers (Stealth)
programme.desc: In the wild it is survival of the fittest, and each creature has its own set of skills and weapons. Viewers will get to know poisonous spiders, fast snakes, camouflaged cuttlefish, ferocious sharks and other deadly animals. This exciting journey will reveal the secrets of the hunters at the top of the food chain. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA

programme.title: d/s Wild animals of Europe (Bison)
programme.desc: Over the course of several seasons, this thrilling film follows a herd of bison whose matriarch has died and a young female has taken over the leadership. She has a huge responsibility - to lead the animals through the forest to better pastures, repelling the attacks of wolves. Will she succeed in this mission? France

programme.title: d/f Dehesa
programme.desc: Dehesa is not just a place, but a real natural pearl of the southwest of the Iberian Peninsula. Here, in a unique ecosystem, man and nature have worked side by side for centuries to create a landscape where harmony reigns. The oak forests and grasslands that support rich flora and fauna reflect the perfect balance between human activity and natural life. Spain

programme.title: d/f Gibbon - a singing monkey. 2 s.
programme.desc: A distinct sound is heard that awakens the quiet forest. Some claim that this sound resembles human singing. These signals serve to convey signals and emotions. These little monkeys protect the life of a huge forest. These are singing monkeys - gibbons. We will reveal the secrets of their mysterious singing. South Korea

programme.title: d/f Italy. Through places of wild nature (Mountain monks of Little Tibet)
programme.desc: This episode explores the biological cycle of Apennine chamois, which are found only in the highest mountains of Central Italy. Apennine chamois are an ancient species, but today they are under serious threat

programme.title: d/f Hippo Island
programme.desc: On the beaches of the Bisagos Islands, located off the coast of Guinea-Bissau in the Atlantic, you can find strange footprints. They belong to hippos, animals that usually live in fresh water. For a long time, scientists could not explain why these powerful mammals find themselves far from their usual bodies of water. Spain

programme.title: t/s Wild killers (Tusks and horns)
programme.desc: In this issue we explore nature's deadly weapons - tusks and horns. We learn how elephants and rhinoceroses use them for defense and attack, and how deer and buffalo turn them into formidable means of survival in battles for territory and the right to life. Dir.: Paul Dean. USA

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild (Always in touch)
programme.desc: Communication and connection is one of the main strategies of the animal world. And the winners are those animals that are able to use it. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. Czech Republic, USA

programme.title: d/f Costa Rica: Ark of Nature
programme.desc: Costa Rica is a hilly Central American country bordered by the Caribbean Sea and Pacific Ocean, known for its beaches, volcanoes and stunning biodiversity. In this amazing corner of the planet, we will meet four unusual wild animals that live in tropical forests and see their life in natural conditions. Russia

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (African savannah)
programme.desc: The authors decided to make a kind of rating of the most outstanding representatives of the animal world. With their research they will help determine which of the animals is the smartest, most dangerous, strong, fastest and toothiest. A complete set of wildness! How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA

programme.title: d/s World of Wildlife (Great Barrier Reef)

How high a bird can fly, who is the most bloodthirsty in the depths of the ocean, and many other stories that will take your breath away. USA

programme.title: d/s Water World of Komodo Island (Kingdom of Dragons)
programme.desc: Indonesia is the largest island state. There are more than seventeen thousand islands. But the most famous of them is Komodo, the kingdom of the legendary monitor lizards. Komodo dragons feel at home on mountain slopes, in forests and on the coast. Germany

programme.title: d/f Wild Slovenia
programme.desc: Slovenia is a country full of natural contrasts. We will visit the majestic Alpine peaks, the hidden forests of the Dinaric Mountains, as well as the Pannonian plains and karst caves. Let's dive into the underground world and enjoy the views of the Adriatic Sea. More than 50 animal species are tracked throughout the year, showing different stages of their life cycle and environmental influences

programme.title: d/s The most poisonous animals in the world (Deserts and oceans)
programme.desc: We will tell you about the poisonous snakes of the Australian wilderness. In the hot sands of the United States, scorpions and lizards use a special combination of toxins to defeat the enemy and obtain food. Australia

programme.title: d/s Strategies in the wild (Kingdom Rules)
programme.desc: The main goal of most creatures is to conquer territory; for such animals, their land is their kingdom. Dir.: Max Serio, Bettina Dalton. Czech Republic, USA

programme.title: Conversations with Animals (Tale of a Turtle)
programme.desc: Greek turtle. European marsh turtle. African snapping turtle. Madagascar striped tortoise. This film takes us to the various habitats of these species, where they suffer the effects of climate change

programme.title: d/f Where the soul lives (Yak)
programme.desc: In this series you will meet the wild yak - the messenger of the snowy mountain. China

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 4 s.
programme.desc: Join charming and energetic Sydney veterinarian Chris Brown and his team as they treat animals in the Bondi Beach area with great care and professionalism. From rescuing pets to caring for wild animals, they face new challenges every day. Watch as they save lives and create miracles, bringing light and hope to the animal world. Australia

programme.title: Wild Japan – land of a thousand islands
programme.desc:
Japan, with its four main islands and over 6,000 mostly uninhabited islets, stretches over 3,000 kilometers from the Sea of ​​Okhotsk to the Philippine Sea. Flora and fauna fascinate. 

On Honshu, the largest island, there is both urban areas and wilderness. At the temple complex, with the world's largest bronze Buddha statue, in the former capital Nara, wild sika deer are the attraction. The Japanese worship them as messengers of the gods. In addition, every year the impressive cherry tree blossoms in spring attract tourists from all over the world.

Macaques are also increasingly venturing out of the hinterland to find more convenient sources of food. For example, the curious monkeys bathe in hot thermal springs. The spectacle attracts many tourists, who in turn throw small treats into the water for the macaques. Only when the monkeys are full do they retreat into the wild in the evening.
